patent.title: 一种连续制备酶切超低分子量透明质酸或其盐的方法
assignees: 山东焦点福瑞达生物股份有限公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E3-N2; process claim; TR01 history includes temporary co-ownership with 山东百阜福瑞达制药 (later reverted). KeyC marking is Freda group brand page.

knowledge_origin.description: Public holdout E3-N2; brand lists process patent as core HA tech.

technology.problem: 酶切超低分子HA工业化：高黏度膜过滤、溶剂消耗、活性炭漏炭、喷雾干燥品质。
technology.mechanism: 粗酶液（指定保藏菌株）+发酵液膜浓缩连续酶解+次氯酸钠脱色+多段冷冻干燥（授权权利要求）。
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior enzyme-cut HA patents cited in background; not independently re-benchmarked.

value_carriers.name: 百阜®Hyaoligo®水解透明质酸钠（候选）
value_carriers.description: Assignee ingredient product describes enzyme-cut ULWHA benefits but does not publish claim-1 process parameters or name this ZL.

value_carriers.name: 珂谧KeyC 超焕活小分子玻尿酸叙事（候选）
value_carriers.description: Group brand page marks ZL202110767111.5 as core patent; finished KeyC SKUs not shown to practice the method claim.

gaps.description: Method claim requires process parameters not disclosed on public brand/ingredient pages; KeyC sticker ≠ practice of claim 1.
needed_evidence: Regulated disclosure that named ingredient lots are made by this process

notes: Holdout E3-N2. T0=2026-10-13. Claims check FAIL (process). Brand ZL list = E2 only → R0; no auto-R3. Formal V0.7/schema 1.0; not V0.8.
